raw_text: Our geolocation team has confirmed the positions of Eritrean military assets in at least four locations across western and central Tigray. Cross-referencing Planet Labs imagery with ground-level social media footage. Vehicle types and markings consistent with Eritrean Defence Forces. Full analysis and coordinates in our upcoming report. This represents a clear ceasefire violation.
clean_text: Bellingcat geolocated Eritrean military assets at four locations in Tigray. Cross-referenced satellite imagery with ground footage. Vehicle markings confirmed as Eritrean Defence Forces.
